title: Fried winter root vegetables
preamble:
Ingredients:-
3
tbsp duck fat, approximate quantity
1
celeriac, peeled, cut into 1.5 cm cubes
2
carrots, cut into fine strips
1/4
Savoy cabbage, roughly chopped
2
cloves garlic, chopped
2
tsp chopped thyme, leaves only

3
tbsp duck fat, approximate quantity
1
celeriac, peeled, cut into 1.5 cm cubes
2
carrots, cut into fine strips
1/4
Savoy cabbage, roughly chopped
2
cloves garlic, chopped
2
tsp chopped thyme, leaves only

Method:-
Melt the duck fat in a deep frying pan set over a medium heat. Tip in the celeriac cubes and fry until browned.
Add the shredded carrot, cabbage, chopped garlic and thyme, and cook for a further 2 minutes; serve hot.
